{{Current events|year=2019|month=10|day=23|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Lion Air Flight 610]], [[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]]
**[[Indonesia]]n investigators meet with families of the deceased ahead of the release of their final report, scheduled for Friday. They state the crash was caused by design flaws with software on the aircraft, and inaccurate assessments by [[Boeing]] as to how pilots would respond to them. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/lion-air-boeing-737-max-design-flaws-tied-indonesia-crash-191023064944012.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Yirol Let L-410 Turbolet crash]]
**[[Ukraine]] releases the final report into the disaster, which was prepared by [[South Sudan]]. The report concludes mistakes by both crew and maintenance, as well as poor weather, combined to cause the crash. [http://avherald.com/h?article=4bd74c51&opt=0 (The Aviation Herald)]

;Health and environment
*[[Pacific Gas and Electric Company|Pacific Gas and Electric]] is set to shut off power to 179,000 customers in [[Northern California]] due to an elevated [[2019 California wildfires|wildfire]] risk, while [[Southern California Edison]] does so for 308,000 in [[Southern California]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/23/business/energy-environment/california-power.html (''The New York Times'')], [https://ktla.com/2019/10/23/socal-edison-could-cut-power-to-over-300000-customers-due-to-wildfire-risk/ (KTLA)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]], [[Turkey–United States relations]]
**The [[Presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] lifts the sanctions it placed on [[Turkey]], in response to the latter's ceasefire. While [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] states the ceasefire is permanent, he threatens to reinstate the sanctions if "something happens that we are not happy with". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-trump/trump-says-turkeys-ceasefire-in-northern-syria-now-permanent-sanctions-lifted-idUSKBN1X223P?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Grays incident]]
**Police discover 39 bodies inside a lorry container in [[Grays]], [[Essex]], [[United Kingdom|UK]]. They had been transported from [[Zeebrugge]], across the [[English Channel]] to [[Purfleet]]. The driver, a man from [[Northern Ireland]], is arrested. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/oct/23/driver-arrested-after-39-bodies-found-in-lorry-container-in-essex (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Right-wing terrorism#United Kingdom|Right-wing terrorism in the United Kingdom]], [[Christchurch mosque shootings]]
**Two men are given prison sentences in the [[United Kingdom]] after they incited copycat attacks following mosque shootings in [[New Zealand]]. They were convicted of a series of [[Terrorism Acts|terror offences]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-tyne-50161137 (BBC News)]
*Police in [[Albania]] say they have identified a terrorist cell in the country operated by the [[Revolutionary Guards of Iran|Revolutionary Guards]] of [[Iran]] and seeking to attack members of exiled Iranian anti-government group [[Mujahedin-e Khalq]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/23/albanian-police-say-iranian-terror-cell-planned-to-attack-exiles (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Murder of Nusrat Jahan Rafi]]
**A court in [[Bangladesh]] sentences sixteen people to death after they burned a student alive when she reported sexual harassment by a teacher. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50138990 (BBC News)]
*[[Trump–Ukraine scandal]]
**At a hearing in [[New York City]], [[Lev Parnas and Igor Fruman]], two associates of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s personal lawyer [[Rudy Giuliani]], who aided him with a search in [[Ukraine]] for detrimental information on President Trump's political opponents, plead not guilty to charges that they funneled $350,000 in illegal donations to a pro-Trump political committee and another $20,000 to former [[United States Republican Party|Republican]] [[United States Congress|Congressman]] [[Pete Sessions]] while acting on behalf of at least one [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] government official. [https://www.aol.com/article/news/2019/10/23/2-giuliani-associates-plead-not-guilty-in-campaign-finance-scheme/23845872/ (AOL)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Botswana general election]]
**Citizens of [[Botswana]] cast their vote to elect the members of the [[National Assembly (Botswana)|National Assembly]] and local government councils. [https://ewn.co.za/2019/10/23/all-systems-go-for-botswana-elections (Eyewitness News)]
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**[[Chilean President]] [[Sebastián Piñera]] in a nationally televised address apologizes for the failures of the [[Government of Chile|government]] and pledges economic reforms as violent protests continue in the country. [https://news.wjct.org/post/chile-president-apologizes-governments-failings-violent-protests-continue (WJCT)]
*[[2019 Bolivian protests]]
**[[Evo Morales]] accuses opposition politicians of plotting a [[coup d'etat]] with foreign powers. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/23/bolivia-evo-morales-coup-accusation-opposition-foreign-powers (''The Guardian'')]
*A lawyer for [[Lev Parnas and Igor Fruman|Lev Parnas]] says some of the evidence collected in his client's case could be subject to [[executive privilege]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/attorney-indicted-giuliani-associate-says-234200451.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting]], [[Fort Lauderdale airport shooting]]
**In a special session of the Florida Senate, the chamber voted 25–15 to uphold the suspension of former [[Broward Sheriff's Office|Broward Sheriff]] [[Scott Israel]] for his agency's response to the mass shootings at both [[Ft. Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport]] and Parkland. [https://www.local10.com/news/politics/florida-senate-votes-to-uphold-decision-to-remove-sheriff-scott-israel-from-office (WPLG)]
*[[September 2019 Israeli legislative election]]
**[[President of Israel]] [[Reuven Rivlin]] tasks Leader of the Opposition [[Benny Gantz]] to try to form government after the failing of current [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/23/israeli-opposition-leader-benny-gantz-to-be-asked-to-form-government (''The Guardian'')]
